lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-linear, staggered grid pattern posterior to the fifth gill slit, transitioning into more defined horizontal rows along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (~5-8 pixels wide) intersecting with horizontal ridge lines to form a checkerboard framework, with high-luminance blobs centered at the intersection coordinates.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient (high luminance on top edge, low luminance/shadow on bottom edge) traversing the upper two-thirds of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance blobs of varying diameters (2-5 pixels) distributed across the primary surface area of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish silhouettes (remoras) clustered at the ventral junction of the pectoral fin and along the lower abdomen.
